Baleful Betrayal.name: Baleful Betrayal
Baleful Betrayal.description: Caster magically warps the target's sense of friend and foe, WIL check to negate. When the target attempts to target a character with an attack, spell, or another effect, the caster can spend a reaction to direct the attack at one of the target's allies within range. After this, the target can immediately re-attempt the WIL check without action cost.

Bend Presence.name: Bend Presence
Bend Presence.description: Caster coats themselves in a mind-altering magical aura that wipes the memories of anyone who views them and replaces themselves with a nondescript figure, WIL save to negate. After this spell ends, those who witness the aura have 5 + 5/F minutes worth of memory before and after wiped, leaving the targets with only vague recollections of the figure. For two finnesses, the caster can instead choose to be remembered as another figure, instead of wiping the memories.

Collapse.name: Collapse
Collapse.description: Caster twists the energies affecting the target against them. The target receives a number of d12s in adaptive damage equivalent to the number of status conditions, continuous, and focus spells they are being affected by, HEA save for half damage.

Compulsion.name: Compulsion
Compulsion.description: The caster hijacks the target's mind and can expend their reaction to grant the target another Core Action, WIL check to negate. What the target does with this Core Action may be decided by the caster. The affected target will believe the action they take is of their own volition. After each time this happens, the target immediately re-attempts the initial check at no action cost.

Daze.name: Daze
Daze.description: Target loses (Rank) memloc'd locations, loses grip of any active focus spells it is maintaining, and is befuddled for 1 + (Rank/5) rounds, WIL save to negate. Resisting this effect allows the target to automatically succeed on saves against Daze for the next 4 rounds.

Fate Link.name: Fate Link
Fate Link.description: Two or more targets become linked together and share effects applied to one or more of them to others in the link; if one of them becomes a target, fails a check or save, or takes damage then it is applied to all in the link (If one becomes a target, they are all targets, if one of them fails a check, they all fail and suffer the consequences, and if one of them takes damage, they all take damage), WIL save to negate being linked. This cannot cause anything to repeat more than once per target. (An AoE does its damage, once, to all in the link but if it hits more than one target in the link it does not repeat its effect more than once.)

Frenzy.name: Frenzy
Frenzy.description: Caster draws arcane magic from the air, directing it towards willing targets. Willing targets are granted 2 +1/4F bonus martial points and have their spells automatically finessed 1 + 1/4F times in a direction of their choice. Additionally, targets receive a placed roll on all STR checks.

Leech.name: Leech
Leech.description: Wrapping themselves or a target in a charming aura, all targets in a 20' radius around the initial target must make a WIL save. On failure, the targets are charmed by the initial target, and become susceptible to suggestions from them. Furthermore, it is impossible to tell the motivation, thoughts, or truthfulness of the initial target by any magical means for the duration of the spell. The caster can choose to display any thoughts of their choosing to those attempting to read their mind.

Loose Lips.name: Loose Lips
Loose Lips.description: Targets are compelled to blurt out information related to a subject that they would not typically share and lose 2 + 1/2F of their INT attribute, WIL save to negate. Targets blurt out a singular sentence.

Major Charm.name: Major Charm
Major Charm.description: Caster can choose to Charm, Confuse, or Petrify the targets, WIL check to negate. Affected targets automatically re-attempt the check at the end of their turn.

Mass Confusion.name: Mass Confusion
Mass Confusion.description: An aromatic mist begins to settle in the area, confusing all caught in its wake, WIL check to negate. Affected targets automatically re-attempt at the end of their turn.

Minor Charm.name: Minor Charm
Minor Charm.description: Caster can choose to Frighten, Deafen, Encourage, Convince, or Blind the target, WIL check to negate. Encouraged targets feel happier and gain a placed roll on origin skill checks.

Shadow Thought.name: Shadow Thought
Shadow Thought.description: Target's course of action may be influenced by the caster, as long as the changes do not conflict with the target's wishes, the target receives an inferior WIL, displaced roll on all skill checks for the duration of the ability, and they struggle to form their thoughts, WIL save to negate.

Tunnel Vision.name: Tunnel Vision
Tunnel Vision.description: The targets' minds are plunged into a mystical void (the appearance of which is chosen by the caster), they become frightened of the caster and mesmerized by the void (whose appearance is determined by the caster), WIL save to negate. While mesmerized, the target can only perceive themselves, the caster, and the mystical void. The spell is broken if the line of sight between the target and the caster is broken.

Twist Mind.name: Twist Mind
Twist Mind.description: Targets receive a nightmare or daydream during their next attempted rest, WIL save to negate. This prevents them from recovering mana, HP, or any other effect normally gained through rest and convinces them of something of the target's choice. Caster can specify a few conditions, such as the nature of the nightmares, if the dream stops when the target reaches a certain location, etc. Targets are not aware they are under magical effects.

Witch's Power.name: Witch's Power
Witch's Power.description: Caster inspires a magically enhanced fervor in a number of willing targets, providing them 2 + 1/4F placed rolls on all resistance checks as well an exceptional PWR. If cast on an unwilling target, they instead have 1 + 1/2F displaced rolls on the setting of all resistance checks, WIL save to negate.
